actions.name: Set up a Monero multisig wallet, with the room carrying the key exchange
actions.partialBecause: ADR-020 S2: the room carries the setup between the members' own wallets (open, join, each round in order, every member disclosing the address its wallet reports), held with real wallets on regtest; no UI offers it yet (S4).
actions.summary: Each member's own wallet runs prepare_multisig; the room carries each member's output to the others, then each wallet runs make_multisig with the threshold and exchange_multisig_keys once or twice, the room carrying every round's data in order. Muster holds none of the keys; it records who sent each round. The resulting address is disclosed into the room by the members whose wallets show the same address.

fields.name: network
fields.means: the Monero network (CAIP-2 monero:<genesis prefix>); stagenet only while upstream calls the scheme experimental

fields.name: threshold
fields.means: M of N: how many members must sign a spend

fields.name: members
fields.means: the N room members whose wallets take part, by room identity

agreement.threshold: every member taking part (N of N) agrees to the setup

requirements.name: monero-multisig-wallet
requirements.target: the member's own Monero multisig wallet (monero-wallet-cli / monero-wallet-rpc, monero-multisig-gui), which holds their key and multisig state

steps.does: names the network, M and the N members.
each member's own wallet runs prepare_multisig, make_multisig and exchange_multisig_keys (once or twice); the room carries every round's output to the others in order.
each member discloses the address their wallet shows; the setup is done when all N match.

refusals.what: a disclosed address that differs between members
refusals.why: the wallets did not reach the same multisig account

actions.ui: Not built: a Key ceremony-style section of the room's accounts panel would carry the rounds.

claims.claim: Muster holds no Monero key and no multisig state: each member's own wallet signs, and the room only carries the files
A malicious member may be able to steal funds: upstream's warning for the scheme stands, so stagenet only

evidence.what: Monero multisig: the setup, the sync before every spend, the signing steps, and the experimental warning
wallet RPC: describe_transfer takes a multisig_txset and returns its recipients, amounts and fee; the multisig methods
the Multisig Messaging System: Monero's own coordination layer over PyBitmessage
monero-multisig-gui: wallet2 embedded, peers over Tor onion services
the setup over the room with scripted wallets: no wallet asked before every member joined, rounds in order, one address disclosed by all, refusals, a forged round dropped
the setup over the room with three real monero-wallet-rpc wallets on regtest: each ready as a 2-of-3 at one address, disclosed by all three

actions.name: Spend from a Monero multisig wallet, agreed in the room, signed by each member's own wallet
actions.partialBecause: ADR-020 S1: the driver (effect, refusals, two rounds, the describe-check) is built and conforms, and a spend ran on regtest; the room does not yet carry the sync, the transaction set or the signing rounds (S3), and no UI offers it (S4).
actions.summary: The room agrees the payment first: recipients and amounts. Before the spend, the members' wallets re-sync partial key images (export_multisig_info / import_multisig_info), the room carrying the blobs. One member's wallet builds the transaction set (transfer); the room carries it; each signer's own wallet runs describe_transfer on it and signs (sign_multisig) only if its recipients and amounts are the agreed ones; any wallet submits (submit_multisig). One spend at a time: the scheme needs a fresh sync after each.

fields.name: account
fields.means: the multisig address disclosed at setup

fields.name: recipients
fields.means: each destination address and amount in atomic units

fields.name: feeCap
fields.means: the most fee the members accept, in atomic units

steps.does: writes the recipients, amounts and fee cap.
each signer's wallet exports its multisig info; the room carries it; the builder's wallet imports the others' and builds the transaction set.

each signer's own wallet runs describe_transfer on the transaction set and signs it with sign_multisig only if its recipients and amounts equal the agreed effect; the room carries it to the next signer.
steps.signs: sign_multisig, by the member's own wallet

steps.does: any member's wallet submits the fully signed set (submit_multisig).
each member's wallet sees the spend at 10 confirmations; the next spend starts with a fresh sync.

refusals.what: signing a transaction set whose recipients or amounts differ from the agreed effect
refusals.why: invariant 1, done by the member's own wallet: Muster cannot decode a Monero transaction set

refusals.what: a second spend before the first has settled and the members re-synced
refusals.why: the scheme refuses stale multisig data ('This signature was made with stale data')

claims.claim: Muster holds no Monero key and no multisig state: each member's own wallet signs, and the room only carries the files
A malicious member may be able to steal funds: upstream's warning for the scheme stands, so stagenet only

evidence.what: Monero multisig: the setup, the sync before every spend, the signing steps, and the experimental warning
wallet RPC: describe_transfer takes a multisig_txset and returns its recipients, amounts and fee; the multisig methods
the Multisig Messaging System: Monero's own coordination layer over PyBitmessage
monero-multisig-gui: wallet2 embedded, peers over Tor onion services
the driver: the effect, the refusals, both rounds' signatures, the describe-check, conformance
